```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
source("utility-functions.R")

#### publications #####
publications <- read_csv("../publications.csv") %>%
  mutate(date=paste(publication_date_year, publication_date_month, publication_date_day, sep='-')) %>%
  mutate(year = publication_date_year) %>%
  filter(include_in_full_cv == 'y') %>%
  arrange(-publication_date_year, -publication_date_month, -publication_date_day)

#### cv entries #####
cv_entries <- read_csv("../cv_entries.csv") %>% 
  filter(include_in_full_cv == 'y') %>%
  mutate(date_start=paste(date_start_year, date_start_month, date_start_day, sep='-')) %>%
  mutate(date_end=paste(date_end_year, date_end_month, date_end_day, sep='-')) %>%
  mutate(year_begin = date_start_year) %>%
  mutate(year_end = date_end_year) %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse((is.na(year_end) | year_begin == year_end),
                      year_begin,
                      str_c(year_begin, "---", year_end))) %>%
  mutate(across(2:4, as.numeric)) %>%
  arrange(-date_start_year, -date_start_month, -date_start_day)
```

## Personal summary {.nohead .set-width-range}
```{block type="grid-item", echo=TRUE}
I am a computational biologist and research leader developing an independent program at the intersection of genomics, evolution, and data science. My work focuses on understanding the origin and function of genes with unknown function (i.e., "dark genes") and building computational approaches that can be applied across diverse biological systems, including microbial, environmental, biomedical, and translational research. I have led collaborative research programs, mentored graduate and undergraduate researchers, and guided projects from scientific question through analysis and publication. I am also a co-founder and former CTO of OceanOmics, where I helped translate research into scalable environmental health technologies and advance multiple platforms to proof of concept.
```

## Publications {.nohead .set-width-year}
```{r}
publications %>%
  mutate(ref2print = str_c(authors_full, " ", title, ". *", journal, "*")) %>%
  mutate(ref2print = ifelse(!is.na(ref_info), 
                            str_c(ref2print, ", ", ref_info, ", ", year(date), "."), 
                            str_c(ref2print, ", ", year(date), "."))
         ) %>%
  mutate(ref2print = ifelse(!is.na(preprint), 
                            str_c(ref2print, " [[Preprint](", preprint, ")]"), 
                            ref2print)
         ) %>%
  mutate(ref2print = ifelse(!is.na(url), 
                            str_c(ref2print, " [[URL](", url, ")]"), 
                            ref2print)
         ) %>%
  mutate(ref2print = ifelse(!is.na(pdf), 
                            str_c(ref2print, " [[PDF](", pdf, ")]"), 
                            ref2print)
         ) %>%
  mutate(ref2print = ifelse(!is.na(additional_info), 
                            str_c(ref2print, " ", additional_info), 
                            ref2print)
         ) %>%
  select(year, ref2print) %>%
#  manual_page_break_after_row("ref2print", "implications for reproduction and population dynamics in two sympatric Hawaiian coral") %>%
  manual_page_break_after_row("ref2print", "PhySortR: a fast, flexible tool for sorting phylogenetic trees in R") %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
